automations.name: Ask AI
automations.tagline: Text in, answer out. The block behind "summarize this", "draft a reply" and anything else you can put in words.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut and pick this one. Pass it one item, or a List with what to work on first and your instructions last. Example: Get Clipboard, then a List of Clipboard and "Summarize in three lines", then Run Shortcut Ask AI.

inside.detail: Or asks you, when run on its own.
Sends what you passed in, and your instructions, to our API with your key.
Hands the answer back to your shortcut. Run on its own, it shows it.

automations.name: Ask AI About an Image
automations.tagline: A photo or screenshot plus a question, answered in words.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut and pick this one. Pass it one item, or a List with what to work on first and your instructions last. Example: Take Screenshot, then a List of Screenshot and "What app is this and what does the error mean?". With no question, it describes the image.

inside.detail: A 1024 pixel JPEG, so every run costs about the same.
Sends what you passed in, and your instructions, to our API with your key.
Hands the answer back to your shortcut. Run on its own, it shows it.

automations.name: Transcribe Audio
automations.tagline: A recording or voice memo in, the words out.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut, pick this one and pass it a recording or audio file. Pair it with Ask AI to summarize what was said. Run on its own, it records until you tap stop.

inside.detail: Only when run on its own.
Sends the recording to our API with your key.
Hands the answer back to your shortcut. Run on its own, it shows it.

automations.name: Pull Out Details
automations.tagline: Name the details you want and get them back as a Dictionary, from text or a photo.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut and pick this one. Pass it one item, or a List with what to work on first and your instructions last. Example: a List of a receipt photo and "total, date, store", then Get Dictionary Value "total".

inside.detail: Only for a photo or screenshot.
Sends what you passed in, and your instructions, to our API with your key.
Then Stop and Output hands the Dictionary back to your shortcut.

automations.name: Pick a Category
automations.tagline: Give it text and a list of choices; it answers with exactly one, ready for an If.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut and pick this one. Pass it one item, or a List with what to work on first and your instructions last. Example: a List of an email and "Urgent: needs action today, Needs reply, FYI", then If Shortcut Result is Urgent.

inside.detail: Sends what you passed in, and your instructions, to our API with your key.
Always one of your choices, written exactly as you gave it.

automations.name: Make an Image
automations.tagline: Describe a picture and get a 1024 pixel image back.
automations.runTip: Add Run Shortcut to your own shortcut, pick this one and pass it a description. Save the result to Photos or set it as your wallpaper. Run on its own, it asks what to draw.

inside.detail: Sends what you passed in, and your instructions, to our API with your key.
Turns the answer into a JPEG.
Hands the answer back to your shortcut. Run on its own, it shows it.

automations.name: Explain This to Me
automations.tagline: Share a bill, lease, lab result or error message and get it in plain English.
automations.runTip: Share a screenshot, photo, PDF or text to it. Run it on its own to explain your latest screenshot.

inside.detail: For a screenshot or photo. Runs on your iPhone, so only the text is sent.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.

automations.name: Summarize This
automations.tagline: Share any article, email or note and get a three-line summary.
automations.runTip: In Safari, Mail or Notes, tap Share and pick Summarize This. Run it on its own to summarize your clipboard.

inside.detail: Whatever you shared, or your clipboard.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
Shows the summary.

automations.name: Draft a Reply
automations.tagline: Copy a message, run it, and get a warm, concise reply on your clipboard.
automations.runTip: Copy a message, then run it. For one tap, set it as your Action Button or Back Tap (Settings, Accessibility, Touch, Back Tap).

inside.detail: Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
Then a notification says the reply is ready to paste.

automations.name: Change the Tone
automations.tagline: Rewrite selected text as friendlier, firmer, or more formal.
automations.runTip: Select text, tap Share and pick Change the Tone. The rewrite lands on your clipboard.

inside.detail: Friendlier, Firmer, More formal or Shorter.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
And shows the rewrite.

automations.name: Turn My Voice into a Note
automations.tagline: Talk for a minute. Get a tidy note with action items in Apple Notes.
automations.runTip: Say "Hey Siri, Turn My Voice into a Note", or set it as your Action Button. It stops listening when you pause.

inside.detail: Transcribed on your iPhone.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
In Apple Notes.

automations.name: Summarize My Meeting Notes
automations.tagline: Record a meeting or lecture and get a summary, decisions and action items in Notes.
automations.runTip: Run it when the meeting starts and tap Done when it ends. The note has the summary on top and the full transcript underneath. Up to about 45 minutes.

inside.detail: Tap Done to stop.
Sends the recording to our API with your key. It transcribes the recording, then writes the notes.
In Apple Notes, with the full transcript underneath.

automations.name: Log My Meal
automations.tagline: Estimate nutrition from a meal photo, then review before saving to Apple Health.
automations.runTip: Take or share a meal photo. Review the estimated calories and macros, then confirm to save or cancel without writing to Health. Photo estimates can be inaccurate and are not medical advice. Health permissions are requested separately.

inside.detail: Or the photo you shared.
A 1024 pixel JPEG, so every run costs about the same.
Sends the photo to our API with your key.
See all four values. Cancel stops without saving anything.
Only after confirmation: estimated dietary energy, protein, carbohydrates and fat.

automations.name: Make Reminders from This
automations.tagline: Share a messy list or email and get one clean reminder per task.
automations.runTip: Share an email or note, or copy a list and run it. Each task becomes its own reminder.

inside.detail: Whatever you shared, or your clipboard.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
One line per task.
For each task.

automations.name: Log a Receipt
automations.tagline: Snap a receipt and log merchant, date and total to a spreadsheet.
automations.runTip: Add it to your Home Screen. Rows go to Receipts.csv in iCloud Drive, in the Shortcuts folder.

inside.detail: Runs on your iPhone. Only the text is sent.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
Receipts.csv in iCloud Drive.

automations.name: Translate This
automations.tagline: Natural translation that keeps names, tone and formatting intact.
automations.runTip: Select text or share a page, tap Share and pick Translate This.

inside.detail: Pick the language.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.

automations.name: Check for a Scam
automations.tagline: Share a suspicious text, email or screenshot and get a straight answer with the red flags.
automations.runTip: Share the message, or a screenshot of it, from Messages, Mail or Photos. Run it on its own to check your latest screenshot.

inside.detail: For a screenshot. Runs on your iPhone, so only the text is sent.
Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.

automations.name: Plan My Day
automations.tagline: A two-paragraph plan for your day from your calendar and reminders.
automations.runTip: In Shortcuts, open Automation, tap +, pick Time of Day and choose Plan My Day so it runs every morning.

inside.detail: Sends the text to our API with your key. Nothing else leaves your phone.
And shows the plan.
